phases.name: Research baseline and architecture
phases.exit_criteria: Scope and source register reviewed; architecture, accounting boundary and launch evidence owners recorded.

phases.name: SaaS foundations
phases.exit_criteria: Two tenants provisioned; identity, scoped roles, approvals, audit and durable jobs pass isolation tests.

phases.name: Design system and application shells
phases.exit_criteria: Responsive office/admin shells and Android local store operate; screen design gates and sync protocol fixtures pass.

phases.name: Companies and inventory master data
phases.exit_criteria: Companies, partners, SKUs, units, warehouse locations and tracking identities import without orphaned references.

phases.name: Stock integrity and core operations
phases.exit_criteria: Opening stock, receipt, issue, reservation and transfer reconcile exactly under concurrency and retries.

phases.name: Purchasing and inbound quality
phases.exit_criteria: Requisition through approved PO, partial receipt and quality release works; rejected stock cannot be allocated.

phases.name: Sales orders and fulfillment
phases.exit_criteria: Quotation through partial pick/pack/dispatch works with correct reservation release and backorders.

phases.name: Traceability, returns and inventory control
phases.exit_criteria: Returns link originals; recalled/expired stock is blocked; blind counts and variances reconcile to ledger.

phases.name: Advanced warehouse and supply workflows
phases.exit_criteria: Routes, waves, replenishment, consignment, dropship, intercompany and kits preserve quantity and ownership.

phases.name: Warehouse Android and hardware
phases.exit_criteria: Real-device offline receipt/pick/count capture survives process death and sync conflicts without double posting.

phases.name: Valuation and accounting boundary
phases.exit_criteria: All costing methods and landed costs reconcile; periods lock; exports are acknowledged without duplicates.

phases.name: Reports, interfaces and migration
phases.exit_criteria: As-of reports match ledgers; imports dry-run; signed webhooks replay safely; customer migration reconciles.

phases.name: Operational readiness and launch
phases.exit_criteria: Security assessment, localization review, backup restoration, load tests and pilot acceptance are evidenced before production.

sources.title: Agreed product decisions
sources.finding: User-confirmed scope: independent inventory SaaS, Ethiopia first, web plus offline Android, valuation/export finance only.
sources.decision: Product decision; not an external capability claim.

sources.title: Odoo supply chain reference
sources.finding: Inventory, purchase and fulfillment workflows provide a reference taxonomy.
sources.decision: Use as a feature comparison, not a parity or licensing promise.

sources.title: Odoo warehouse routes
sources.finding: Location-based routes support staged inbound/outbound operations.
sources.decision: Adopt explicit templates and route versions; do not copy Odoo internals.

sources.title: Odoo tracking barcodes
sources.finding: Lot and serial identifiers can be captured through barcode operations.
sources.decision: Require server-side identity validation independently of scanner input.

sources.title: Odoo stock valuation operations
sources.finding: Stock valuation and accounting-entry timing are distinct concerns.
sources.decision: Our immutable inventory subledger exports proposals to an external ledger; no Odoo accounting timing is copied.

sources.title: Odoo FEFO removal
sources.finding: Removal dates can prioritize stock selection before expiry.
sources.decision: Physical selection and financial costing remain separate policies.

sources.title: GS1 application identifiers
sources.finding: Application identifiers distinguish product, batch, serial and date data within supported symbols.
sources.decision: Implement a tested subset and preserve separators; no invented GS1 prefixes.

sources.title: Odoo purchase templates
sources.finding: Purchase templates and blanket agreements serve different repeat-purchase purposes.
sources.decision: Implement explicit supplier agreements and approved releases; omit vendor billing.

sources.title: Odoo cycle counts
sources.finding: Location-based periodic counting supports physical/system reconciliation.
sources.decision: Add blind observations, movement-aware reconciliation and independent variance approval.

sources.title: PostgreSQL row security
sources.finding: RLS filters row access, but superusers/BYPASSRLS and normally table owners can bypass it.
sources.decision: Use a non-owner application role, FORCE RLS for scoped tables and raw-role isolation tests.

sources.title: Flutter offline-first architecture
sources.finding: Repositories can combine local persistence and remote synchronization.
sources.decision: Warehouse commands stay pending until authoritative validation; never merge stock with last-write-wins.

sources.title: Odoo replenishment
sources.finding: Reorder rules derive replenishment from forecast shortages.
sources.decision: Suggestions require buyer acceptance and normal purchasing approvals.

sources.title: OWASP API object authorization
sources.finding: Manipulated object identifiers expose missing authorization checks.
sources.decision: Test every identifier-bearing route and indirect worker/export/mobile path.

sources.title: Odoo consignment
sources.finding: Custody and ownership differ for consigned goods.
sources.decision: Maintain owner dimension in all stock buckets and exclude partner-owned stock from company value.

sources.title: Ethiopian Personal Data Protection Proclamation
sources.finding: The Ministry of Justice lists the Personal Data Protection Proclamation.
sources.decision: Applicability, hosting, retention, rights handling and cross-border transfer require qualified review before pilot; no legal interpretation or certification asserted.

sources.title: Odoo landed costs
sources.finding: Additional acquisition charges can be assigned to stock valuation.
sources.decision: Accept external charge evidence without implementing vendor bills; allocate and reconcile exact totals.

features.title: Research baseline
features.requirement: Each agreed feature has an official source or an explicit product decision and a disposition.

features.title: Ethiopia localization review
features.requirement: Record reviewed legal sources, applicability, reviewer, date and approval for data hosting, retention and document wording before pilot; tax invoices are excluded.

features.title: Dependency and version decisions
features.requirement: Verify supported versions and licenses of Node, Express, React, PostgreSQL, Flutter and chosen libraries before lockfile creation; record exact versions in an ADR.

features.title: Reproducible development stack
features.requirement: A clean checkout boots API, worker, web, admin and PostgreSQL through documented Make targets without production credentials.

features.title: CI and contract generation
features.requirement: Typechecks, lint, unit tests, API drift checks, integration tests and plan validation are separate visible CI jobs.

features.title: Environment separation
features.requirement: Development, staging and production use separate credentials, databases, storage and notification destinations.

features.title: Tenant onboarding
features.requirement: A new customer gets isolated settings and an initial administrator; duplicate slug retry returns the original tenant.

features.title: Operator-managed plans
features.requirement: Versioned feature and storage limits are enforced in API and worker paths; no card processing is implemented.

features.title: Suspension and reactivation
features.requirement: Suspended customers cannot post new stock but retain authorized export access; reactivation does not replay old commands automatically.

features.title: Invite and recovery
features.requirement: Invitation and password-reset tokens are single-use, expire and cannot change tenant scope.

features.title: MFA and sessions
features.requirement: MFA is mandatory for platform and tenant administrators; recovery codes are hashed, single-use and audited.

features.title: Device revocation
features.requirement: A revoked Android device loses sync access immediately online; local unlock expires within 24 hours offline and queued work requires renewed authorization.

features.title: Permission catalog
features.requirement: Each action has a declared permission; default roles and custom roles use the same authorization path.

features.title: Tenant company warehouse boundaries
features.requirement: Grants union only within their authorized scopes; foreign tenant IDs and warehouse IDs are denied even when object UUIDs are known.

features.title: Support access
features.requirement: Time-limited customer-approved support sessions are read-only by default and separately audited; platform staff never inherit unrestricted warehouse access.

features.title: Policy routing
features.requirement: Company and warehouse policies resolve deterministically using most-specific scope then amount threshold; missing approver configuration blocks submission.

features.title: Separation of duties
features.requirement: Requesters cannot approve their own adjustment, PO, scrap, period close or intercompany transaction.

features.title: Approval versioning
features.requirement: Submission snapshots policy and document version; editing an approved document requires a new revision and approval.

features.title: Transactional audit
features.requirement: Every sensitive mutation writes its audit and outbox record in the same database transaction or fully rolls back.

features.title: Append-only evidence
features.requirement: Application roles cannot edit or delete audit records; corrections reference the original action.

features.title: Event privacy
features.requirement: Event payloads contain scoped identifiers and necessary facts only; secrets and contact data are excluded from analytics.

features.title: Idempotent commands
features.requirement: Same key and same payload return the original committed result; same key with different payload returns 409.

features.title: Outbox processing
features.requirement: Worker crash before or after delivery never duplicates downstream postings; consumers deduplicate by event ID.

features.title: Retries and dead letters
features.requirement: Exponential retry with jitter stops after eight attempts and raises an actionable dead-letter alert; manual replay retains the original correlation ID.

features.title: Private attachments
features.requirement: Upload size and MIME limits, malware quarantine and entity authorization apply before a file becomes downloadable.

features.title: Comments and evidence
features.requirement: Scoped comments and attachments remain linked to business documents after archival; personal data export and retention rules apply.

features.title: Notification routing
features.requirement: Approval, shortage, expiry, recall and sync-conflict events target authorized recipients only.

features.title: Delivery and preferences
features.requirement: In-app and email notifications deduplicate by recipient and event; transactional security notices cannot be disabled.

features.title: Accessible visual system
features.requirement: Shared typography, spacing, color, forms and tables cover light/dark themes, keyboard navigation and WCAG 2.2 AA acceptance checks.

features.title: Screen state contracts
features.requirement: Every screen defines loading, empty, permission-denied, error, offline and lifecycle states across 375/768/1280/1920/2560 widths.

features.title: Office context switching
features.requirement: Company and warehouse context is visible on every operational screen; switching clears stale query caches and unsaved work is confirmed.

features.title: Platform admin separation
features.requirement: Tenant administration and platform support use separate navigation and permissions; bundles are not the security boundary.

features.title: Search and navigation
features.requirement: Keyboard search uses authorized results and preserves tenant/company context in deep links.

features.title: Durable local repository
features.requirement: Encrypted SQLite cache and command queue survive process death; tenant switching wipes cached data before a new bootstrap.

features.title: Sync protocol foundation
features.requirement: Cursor-based pulls, tombstones, command IDs and ordered dependencies have executable protocol fixtures before business mobile screens.

features.title: Pending versus posted
features.requirement: Offline captures display pending status and never claim stock is committed until server acknowledgement.

features.title: Company and branch setup
features.requirement: Codes are unique within tenant/company; active warehouses prevent hard deletion of their parent.

features.title: Regional defaults
features.requirement: New companies default to ETB, English and Africa/Addis_Ababa; UTC instants and company-local business dates remain distinct.

features.title: Currency governance
features.requirement: Company base currency is immutable after the first valued movement; foreign-currency orders snapshot exchange rates with source and effective date.

features.title: Partner directory
features.requirement: A partner may be both supplier and customer; archive blocks new orders while retaining history.

features.title: Partner commercial references
features.requirement: Supplier SKU, purchase unit, minimum order and lead time are effective-dated; customer item codes do not overwrite internal SKUs.

features.title: Contact privacy
features.requirement: Contact exports and deletion/anonymization follow retention rules without deleting stock evidence.

features.title: Product and variant catalog
features.requirement: SKU and barcode uniqueness are enforced per company; variant attribute combinations cannot duplicate.

features.title: Tracking configuration
features.requirement: None, lot or serial tracking is chosen before stock exists; changing it requires a controlled migration and reconciliation.

features.title: Packaging and barcode aliases
features.requirement: Multiple packaging barcodes resolve to explicit unit quantities; a carton scan cannot silently count as one base unit.

features.title: Catalog import
features.requirement: CSV dry-run reports row-level duplicate codes and invalid references; accepted batches are idempotent.

features.title: Unit conversions
features.requirement: Convert only within a unit category using exact rational factors; snapshot conversions on document lines.

features.title: Quantity precision
features.requirement: Quantities use decimal strings with at most six fractional digits; serial quantities are whole units and conversion remainder must be explicitly resolved.

features.title: Monetary precision
features.requirement: Unit costs and rates use fixed precision; extended amounts round half-up to currency minor units once at document boundaries with deterministic remainder allocation.

features.title: Location hierarchy
features.requirement: Warehouse, zone and bin form an acyclic tree; supplier, customer, inventory-loss and transit locations have explicit types.

features.title: Operational areas
features.requirement: Receiving, quarantine, stock, packing and dispatch locations have reservation eligibility rules.

features.title: Archival and capacity
features.requirement: Occupied or reserved locations cannot be archived; putaway cannot exceed configured capacity without a supervisor-approved exception.

features.title: Lot and serial identity
features.requirement: Tracking identifiers are company/product scoped; a serial cannot simultaneously exist in two physical locations.

features.title: Ownership dimensions
features.requirement: Every stock bucket distinguishes company-owned and partner-owned goods; supplier custody is not company valuation.

features.title: Receipt tracking requirements
features.requirement: Tracked products cannot be posted without lot/serial allocation; early phases may create identities but advanced recall controls arrive in phase 8.

features.title: Posting transaction
features.requirement: Lock affected buckets in canonical order; move, balance, cost fact, command receipt, audit and outbox commit atomically.

features.title: No negative physical stock
features.requirement: Concurrent outgoing moves cannot reduce a controlled physical bucket below zero; shortages return a typed conflict without partial effects.

features.title: Reversal and rebuild
features.requirement: Posted rows are immutable; eligible reversals reference originals and a rebuild from movements reproduces projections exactly.

features.title: Cost fact capture
features.requirement: Receipt/issue source costs, conversion factors and ownership are preserved from day one for phase 11 valuation replay; financial go-live is gated until valuation is complete.

features.title: Atomic allocation
features.requirement: Two concurrent orders requesting the same ten units can reserve at most ten in total.

features.title: Partial allocation and release
features.requirement: Partial fills identify remaining demand; cancel, expiry and short-pick release only unconsumed reservations.

features.title: Availability and forecast
features.requirement: Available equals eligible on-hand minus active reservations; forecast adds dated confirmed receipts and subtracts outstanding demand without double-counting reservations.

features.title: Opening stock
features.requirement: Approved opening batches load quantities, tracking and cost basis once with reconciliation totals and a migration reference.

features.title: Receipt and internal issue
features.requirement: Done quantities are validated against unit/tracking rules; controlled over-receipts require explicit approval.

features.title: Partial operations and backorders
features.requirement: Posting part of a document creates a linked remainder or cancels it explicitly; replay never creates a second backorder.

features.title: Immediate and staged transfers
features.requirement: In-warehouse moves commit once; inter-warehouse shipment moves stock into transit until destination receipt.

features.title: Partial receipt and discrepancy
features.requirement: Received quantity cannot exceed shipped balance; missing or damaged quantities stay in transit until approved return/scrap resolution.

features.title: Transfer conservation
features.requirement: Company-owned quantities sum equally across source, transit and destination before and after transfer; retries preserve totals.

features.title: Requisition and quotation comparison
features.requirement: Approved need produces RFQs; offers compare converted units, currency, lead time and landed-cost estimates without hiding original prices.

features.title: Approved PO revisions
features.requirement: Approved orders snapshot commercial terms; amendment preserves prior revision and reapproves changed commitments.

features.title: Blanket order releases
features.requirement: Call-offs cannot exceed approved quantity/value ceiling or validity dates without a new agreement revision.

features.title: Purchase cancellation
features.requirement: Cancel only unreceived quantities; received quantities require vendor-return workflow rather than destructive edits.

features.title: PO receipt matching
features.requirement: Partial deliveries track ordered, received and outstanding quantities independently; receipt references deduplicate within supplier/company.

features.title: Receive to quarantine
features.requirement: Inspection-required stock posts into quarantine; accepted goods become available only after quality release.

features.title: Receipt cost snapshot
features.requirement: Purchase price, exchange rate and unit conversion are copied onto cost facts without creating a vendor bill.

features.title: Inspection execution
features.requirement: Required checklist results and evidence must be complete before disposition; inspector authority is warehouse scoped.

features.title: Split disposition
features.requirement: Accepted plus rejected quantities equal inspected quantity; release moves accepted stock only and leaves rejected stock blocked.

features.title: Reinspection and evidence
features.requirement: Failed items require a new linked inspection; prior results remain immutable.

features.title: Quotation and pricing
features.requirement: Server resolves effective price tier and currency; discounts beyond configured authority require approval.

features.title: Sales confirmation
features.requirement: Confirmation snapshots terms and creates fulfillment demand; insufficient stock produces partial allocation/backorder rather than a fictitious sale of available stock.

features.title: Order changes
features.requirement: Shipped quantities cannot be cancelled; edits to unfulfilled demand release/recompute reservations and version checks prevent lost updates.

features.title: Pick verification
features.requirement: Location, SKU, lot/serial and actual quantity match the assigned task; short-picks release missing reservation and record reason.

features.title: Packing control
features.requirement: Package contents cannot exceed picked stock; repacking preserves traceability and labels identify packages uniquely.

features.title: Dispatch and delivery records
features.requirement: Dispatch consumes reservations and posts outgoing stock exactly once; packing slip is explicitly not a tax invoice.

features.title: Linked return entitlement
features.requirement: Cumulative returned quantities cannot exceed original delivered/received quantities; serial returns must match originals.

features.title: Customer return inspection
features.requirement: Returned stock enters quarantine, then restock or scrap; original movement cost basis is retained for valuation.

features.title: Vendor returns
features.requirement: Rejected or authorized stock ships to supplier and adjusts PO receiving status according to explicit replace-or-close choice; no credit note is issued here.

features.title: Expiry and FEFO
features.requirement: Removal date drives FEFO with deterministic lot tie-breaks; expired, recalled or quarantined stock is not reservable.

features.title: Recall genealogy
features.requirement: Lot/serial trace traverses receipts, internal moves, shipments and returns; affected customer contacts are access-controlled.

features.title: Approved scrap
features.requirement: Scrap posts to a loss location only after approval and evidence; quantities and value remain traceable through reversal rules.

features.title: Blind and cycle counting
features.requirement: Counter sees required identities but not system quantity; location schedules generate count assignments without duplicates.

features.title: Moving-stock reconciliation
features.requirement: Snapshot plus timestamped movements is reconciled to each count observation; ambiguous late/offline observations require recount before posting.

features.title: Variance approval
features.requirement: Independent approval posts signed adjustments once; zero variance produces no movement and original observations remain immutable.

features.title: Multi-step routes
features.requirement: One/two/three-step inbound and outbound templates create dependent operations exactly once; activated route versions are snapshotted per operation.

features.title: Putaway and capacity
features.requirement: Rules choose eligible destinations deterministically by priority and free capacity; no eligible destination creates an exception task.

features.title: Cross-docking
features.requirement: Incoming accepted stock can satisfy outbound demand without visiting storage while retaining reservation, ownership and inspection requirements.

features.title: Batch and wave formation
features.requirement: Group compatible pick tasks within one warehouse and ownership boundary; a task belongs to only one active released batch.

features.title: Picking strategies
features.requirement: Support piece, batch and wave execution using configured FIFO/FEFO/nearest-location selection; costing method remains independent from physical selection.

features.title: Replanning exceptions
features.requirement: Short-picks and cancellations replan only uncompleted work without losing completed scan evidence.

features.title: Min-max and safety stock
features.requirement: Dated forecast below minimum suggests replenishment to maximum with purchase multiples, lead time and explicit safety buffer.

features.title: Buyer approval
features.requirement: Accepted suggestion creates a draft requisition or PO for normal approval; rerunning planning does not duplicate existing supply.

features.title: Pick-face replenishment
features.requirement: Bin replenishment moves eligible reserve stock to pick locations and reports shortages without generating impossible transfers.

features.title: Consignment custody
features.requirement: Partner-owned stock appears in custody quantities but is excluded from company-owned value and unavailable to unrelated owner demand.

features.title: Ownership acquisition
features.requirement: Approved acquisition changes ownership through paired ledger movements and a documented cost basis; custody location need not change.

features.title: Owner returns
features.requirement: Unsold consignment returns to its owner without treating it as a company-owned inventory sale.

features.title: Linked supplier fulfillment
features.requirement: Eligible sales demand creates linked purchase demand without reserving warehouse stock.

features.title: Supplier delivery evidence
features.requirement: Confirmation updates fulfillment and external-location movement history exactly once; internal on-hand remains unchanged.

features.title: Dropship returns
features.requirement: Return authorization records supplier/customer routing and ownership without manufacturing a warehouse receipt.

features.title: Paired commercial documents
features.requirement: Within one tenant, approved intercompany requests create linked sale/purchase documents with explicit currencies and prices.

features.title: Company-local ledgers
features.requirement: Shipment and receipt use each company ledger and base currency; buyer receipt is not posted before physical receipt.

features.title: Independent permissions
features.requirement: Users require explicit rights in each company for paired actions; no cross-tenant automatic trading is permitted in baseline.

features.title: Phantom kit definitions
features.requirement: Versioned kits explode into stock components; cyclic/nested definitions are validated and no manufactured finished-stock balance is created.

features.title: Kit allocation and fulfillment
features.requirement: Available kits equal the limiting component quantity; partial-kit dispatch is blocked unless order is explicitly revised to components.

features.title: Kit returns
features.requirement: Return evidence identifies actual components and original allocation costs rather than inventing a kit valuation layer.

features.title: Offline operational capture
features.requirement: Receipt, transfer, pick, pack and count observations queue durably with source document version and command dependencies.

features.title: Conflict review
features.requirement: Insufficient stock, revoked permissions, changed documents and expired task leases create explicit actionable conflicts; stock quantities never use last-write-wins.

features.title: Reconnect recovery
features.requirement: Airplane mode, process death, duplicated batches and intermittent acknowledgements produce one committed operation or one visible unresolved conflict.

features.title: Camera and handheld scanning
features.requirement: Camera, keyboard-wedge and Android intent scanner adapters normalize input without dropping GS1 separators or leading zeroes.

features.title: GS1 parsing
features.requirement: Parse GTIN, lot, serial and expiry application identifiers with length/check-digit validation; internal labels never impersonate assigned GS1 company prefixes.

features.title: Label generation and reprints
features.requirement: PDF and ZPL interfaces support product, bin, lot and package labels; retries/reprints preserve entity IDs and are logged.

features.title: FIFO costing
features.requirement: Outgoing owned stock consumes oldest eligible company/product cost layers; physical picking strategy does not change costing order.

features.title: Weighted-average costing
features.requirement: Incoming cost updates the exact moving average; issues use the current average and rounding residual stays reconciled to remaining value.

features.title: Standard costing
features.requirement: Approved standard cost versions apply prospectively and price differences are recorded as valuation variance, not silently dropped.

features.title: Returns and replay
features.requirement: Returns reverse original issue/receipt basis; replay of immutable cost facts yields the same quantity/value totals and identifies any missing historical basis.

features.title: Charge allocation
features.requirement: Freight, duty and handling charges from external evidence allocate by quantity, value, weight or volume; missing bases block allocation.

features.title: Remainder and consumed stock
features.requirement: Allocation sums exactly to total charges; already-consumed shares create linked valuation adjustments rather than rewriting posted issue rows.

features.title: Approved revaluation
features.requirement: Revaluation records reason, authorization and effective open period; standard-cost changes produce explicit remaining-stock delta.

features.title: Period reconciliation
features.requirement: Owned stock quantities and value reconcile by product/company; transit, consignment and external locations are separately explained.

features.title: Close prerequisites
features.requirement: Missing costs, unresolved valuation errors and unreviewed export differences block close; late physical activity posts in the current open period with original occurrence date retained.

features.title: Controlled reopen
features.requirement: Reopen requires independent approval and reason; a new close/export revision supersedes the old one without deleting evidence.

features.title: Balanced export format
features.requirement: Versioned CSV/JSON inventory journal proposals balance by currency and map every line to valuation evidence; missing external account mappings block release.

features.title: Delivery acknowledgement
features.requirement: Same batch ID and checksum replay safely; conflicting acknowledgement is rejected and partial rejection stays visible for reconciliation.

features.title: Accounting boundary
features.requirement: External ledger owns posting and financial statements; the product emits inventory proposals only and never claims to create invoices, bills or bank transactions.

features.title: As-of stock and value
features.requirement: Stock card, on-hand, reserved, transit, owner, aging and value reports reconcile to the ledger at the same as-of instant.

features.title: Service metrics
features.requirement: Fulfillment rate, backorder age, purchase lead-time variance and supplier acceptance rate have published numerator/denominator definitions.

features.title: Secure exports
features.requirement: Large reports run as scoped jobs; permissions are rechecked on download and expired export URLs cannot be reused.

features.title: Public API contracts
features.requirement: API keys are hashed, scoped, expiring and revocable; cursor pagination, rate limits and documented error shapes apply consistently.

features.title: Signed webhooks
features.requirement: HMAC signatures cover timestamp and raw body; replay window, secret rotation, destination validation and SSRF protection are tested.

features.title: Versioned imports
features.requirement: Dry-run validates references and duplicates before commit; error CSV names exact rows and no partial stock posting is hidden.

features.title: Connector boundary
features.requirement: Generic CSV/API/webhook adapters ship; named accounting, courier and payment connectors remain explicit later-scope entries.

features.title: Mapping and rehearsal
features.requirement: Map master data, opening quantities, tracking, ownership, reservations and opening cost layers with source checksums and reconciliation reports.

features.title: Cutover controls
features.requirement: Freeze source writes, apply the final delta, reconcile totals and obtain named customer approval before enabling production posting.

features.title: Rollback boundary
features.requirement: Before first new live movement restore the rehearsed snapshot; afterward use forward corrections and replay accepted commands rather than deleting live history.

features.title: Support runbooks
features.requirement: Customer-approved support access is time-bounded and logged; cross-tenant searching requires a platform purpose and exposes minimum metadata.

features.title: Tenant portability
features.requirement: Export includes master data, documents, stock and valuation ledgers, attachments manifest and schema version; completeness is reconciled before delivery.

features.title: Offboarding and holds
features.requirement: Offboarding revokes access, schedules configured deletion and respects documented legal holds; backup expiry and data-destruction evidence are tracked.

features.title: Isolation assessment
features.requirement: Negative tests cover API, raw application-role SQL, jobs, files, reports, mobile and integrations across two tenants and two companies.

features.title: Privacy rights and retention
features.requirement: Export/anonymize contact data while retaining permitted transaction evidence; retention and hosting decisions require reviewed Ethiopian legal applicability, not assumed durations.

features.title: Launch security
features.requirement: Threat model, dependency/license scans, penetration-test findings and critical/high vulnerability closure are signed off before pilot.

features.title: Observability
features.requirement: Metrics expose posting latency, lock conflicts, sync lag, dead letters, export failures, backup age and per-tenant resource saturation without PII.

features.title: Backup and recovery
features.requirement: Encrypted backups and point-in-time recovery are rehearsed to a separate environment; target RPO is 15 minutes and RTO is four hours.

features.title: Performance budgets
features.requirement: At the documented launch dataset, online reads meet p95 500ms and stock posting p95 one second; Android critical flows work on a mid-range device with intermittent connectivity.

features.title: Safe deployment
features.requirement: Expand-contract migrations and tested rollback/forward-fix procedures preserve committed stock and valuation history.

features.title: Pilot scenario coverage
features.requirement: Distributor, retailer warehouse and lot/expiry business pilots each sign off purchase-to-stock, order-to-dispatch, returns, counts and exports.

features.title: Training and support
features.requirement: Role-based quick starts, barcode-device setup, offline conflict guidance and escalation contacts are delivered and exercised.

features.title: Production go-live
features.requirement: All phase gates pass, critical defects are closed, restore evidence is current and customer acceptance is recorded; failed gates block release.

critical_scenarios.title: Concurrent reservation
critical_scenarios.steps: Create ten available units. Submit two concurrent reservations of seven with different keys.
critical_scenarios.expected: Total active reservations never exceed ten; losing request returns shortage or a documented partial allocation; no negative bucket.

critical_scenarios.title: Atomic posting failure
critical_scenarios.steps: Inject failure between movement, projection, audit and outbox writes. Retry the same command.
critical_scenarios.expected: All writes roll back together; retry commits once and every projection matches the ledger.

critical_scenarios.title: Duplicate and conflicting command
critical_scenarios.steps: Post a receipt twice with the same command ID, then reuse the ID with a changed quantity.
critical_scenarios.expected: First two responses identify one receipt; changed payload returns 409 and creates no movement.

critical_scenarios.title: Partial receipt and backorder
critical_scenarios.steps: Order 100, receive 60, accept 55 and reject five, then receive the remaining 40.
critical_scenarios.expected: Stock totals reflect 55 accepted, five quarantined/rejected and 40 newly inspected; order quantities and backorders do not duplicate.

critical_scenarios.title: Transfer discrepancy
critical_scenarios.steps: Ship 20 to transit, receive 18, report two damaged, obtain scrap approval.
critical_scenarios.expected: Source decreases 20, destination increases 18, transit decreases only when receipt and scrap are posted; loss is two and conservation holds.

critical_scenarios.title: Unauthorized scope everywhere
critical_scenarios.steps: Use tenant A credentials with tenant B IDs in API, raw app-role SQL, jobs, signed downloads, reports, sync and API keys.
critical_scenarios.expected: No foreign row, attachment, event or balance leaks; all mutation attempts are rejected and logged without leaking private data.

critical_scenarios.title: Serial uniqueness and returns
critical_scenarios.steps: Receive serial S once, attempt duplicate receipt, ship it, return twice.
critical_scenarios.expected: A serial has one physical position; duplicate receipt and excessive return are rejected; first return goes to quarantine.

critical_scenarios.title: Recall and expiry race
critical_scenarios.steps: Reserve a lot, activate recall or reach removal date, then attempt dispatch.
critical_scenarios.expected: Dispatch rechecks eligibility and blocks; released reservations and affected customer trace remain auditable.

critical_scenarios.title: Blind count with moving stock
critical_scenarios.steps: Snapshot 100, ship ten, observe 88, receive five, submit a late offline observation.
critical_scenarios.expected: System reconciles observation-time movements; variance is not computed from a stale end balance; ambiguity requests recount; approved adjustment posts once.

critical_scenarios.title: Costing and rounding
critical_scenarios.steps: Receive 10 at ETB 2 and 10 at ETB 4; issue 12. Repeat with fractional units and return two original issued units.
critical_scenarios.expected: FIFO issue value is ETB 28 and remaining value ETB 32; moving average issue value is ETB 36 and remaining value ETB 24; returns restore original allocated basis and all minor-unit residuals reconcile.

critical_scenarios.title: Landed costs after consumption
critical_scenarios.steps: Allocate ETB 10.01 over three equal receipt shares after one share has been consumed.
critical_scenarios.expected: Allocated minor units sum to 1001; deterministic remainder assignment and consumed-stock adjustment preserve original rows and explain the full delta.

critical_scenarios.title: Period lock and late receipt
critical_scenarios.steps: Close a period, submit a late-dated receipt and attempt a direct valuation edit.
critical_scenarios.expected: Original occurrence date is retained; accounting effect goes to the current open period; locked entries cannot be silently changed.

critical_scenarios.title: Accounting acknowledgement replay
critical_scenarios.steps: Deliver batch B, lose response, retry, receive a partial rejection, then a corrected acknowledgement.
critical_scenarios.expected: External references and checksum prevent duplicate proposals; rejected lines stay visible; reconciliation cannot falsely show fully accepted.

critical_scenarios.title: Offline lifecycle
critical_scenarios.steps: Capture a pick and count offline, kill/restart app, change document online, revoke device and reconnect with duplicate commands.
critical_scenarios.expected: Queue survives encrypted; unacknowledged work stays pending; stale version and revoked authorization conflict; no last-write-wins or duplicate stock.

critical_scenarios.title: Ownership and kits
critical_scenarios.steps: Store ten vendor-owned and five owned units; sell a two-component kit with one unavailable owned component.
critical_scenarios.expected: Vendor stock does not inflate company value or satisfy unrelated ownership demand; incomplete kit dispatch is blocked.

critical_scenarios.title: Webhook security
critical_scenarios.steps: Replay signed payload, alter body, use expired timestamp, rotate secret and target private network address.
critical_scenarios.expected: Receiver deduplicates event IDs; tamper/expired signatures and SSRF destinations fail; retries do not duplicate side effects.

critical_scenarios.title: Restore and cutover
critical_scenarios.steps: Rehearse migration, capture customer reconciliation, restore isolated backup and replay the approved post-backup command set.
critical_scenarios.expected: Stock, reservations, valuations and export references reconcile; measured RPO <=15 minutes and RTO <=4 hours; no blind restoration over new live movements.

critical_scenarios.title: Forecast without double counting
critical_scenarios.steps: Have 100 on hand, 30 reserved against 40 open demand and 20 confirmed future receipts.
critical_scenarios.expected: Available is 70; forecast at receipt horizon is 80, not 50; unconfirmed suggestions do not count as supply.

critical_scenarios.title: Intercompany and dropship
critical_scenarios.steps: Fulfill a dropship and a linked intercompany shipment/partial receipt in distinct base currencies.
critical_scenarios.expected: Dropship never increases warehouse on-hand; intercompany ledgers reconcile independently with snapshotted FX and buyer stock only on receipt.
